summary.text: The Spanish version of resolution WHA71.7 on digital health opens with a preamble recalling earlier eHealth resolutions and recognizing the potential of digital technologies for the Sustainable Development Goals. It notes that human interaction remains key and highlights recent progress in national digital health strategies.
